component.name: Gator
component.summary: Secure P2P file transfers with croc

description.p: Gator is a Material 3 frontend for the croc command-line tool, making secure peer-to-peer file and text transfers simple on Linux and Android.
This Flatpak bundles the Flutter Linux build and a matching croc binary so no host croc install is required. Use the same codes with the GTK Gator app (org.gator.Gator) or plain croc 11+.
